task_description: Make the Electron app load faster. Covers: font loading consolidation and display:swap, caching headers for Netlify/Vercel, Vite manualChunks improvements (motion, gsap, modulePreload polyfill), React.lazy for MoviesView, and image lazy loading for quiz photos.

verification.summary: Vite build passes in 7.19s from artifacts/electron (PORT=5000 BASE_PATH=/ npx vite build). TypeScript check has a pre-existing TS2688 error unrelated to these changes. Semantic review passed v2 (APPROVED). All 5 features completed. Review issues all resolved: font preload uses non-blocking onload pattern, sw.js has explicit no-cache header before /*.js rule, framer-vendor chunk guard uses trailing-slash delimiter. Chunk improvements: added react-vendor (58.57kB gz) and framer-vendor (40.03kB gz). Cache headers added to netlify.toml and vercel.json for /assets/* and js/css files. Quiz images use loading=lazy + decoding=async.
